text: Whoa - no ring creature? Go back and see Oddrin before the grass eats you.
You're the new warden? Good timing. Gyria have made camp east of here - Ashfen, they call it.
Scouts in the grass, archers in the trees. And they've taken one of their own prisoner. Strange, that.
Take the road east past the ledges. Rest at the Shrine stone to the north if you need it.
East is Ashfen. North is the Shrine - there's a Ring Stone there if you need one.
